# Reconcile Compilation

This allows for processing of merged pull requests and direct commits that occurred after a specific watermark. It ensures that each item is processed only once and maintains idempotence in the compilation workflow.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
